description: This file defines the ModelReader class responsible for loading, parsing, and managing entity definitions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It reads entity XML configurations, builds entity models, manages caches, and handles relationships, including view-entities and extend-entities.

classes.name: ModelReader
classes.description: A final class responsible for reading, parsing, and managing entity models from XML resource files in Apache OFBiz framework. It supports caching, entity validation, relationship auto-creation, and handles both standard and view entities.

methods.name: getModelReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton ModelReader instance for a given delegator name, creating and caching one if necessary.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs a ModelEntity or ModelViewEntity from an XML Element, associating it with its resource handler.

methods.name: getEntityCache
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches all entity models from the resource files, including processing of extend-entity and view-entity elements.

methods.name: rebuildResourceHandlerEntities
methods.description: Rebuilds the mapping of resource handlers to entity names after manual modifications.

methods.name: getResourceHandlerEntitiesKeyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over resource handlers used in the entity model.

methods.name: getResourceHandlerEntities
methods.description: Returns collection of entity names associated with a specific resource handler.

methods.name: addEntityToResourceHandler
methods.description: Adds a new entity to the resource handler map with specified loader name and location.

methods.name: getEntityResourceHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the resource handler associated with a specific entity name.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Fetches a ModelEntity object by name, throwing exceptions if it does not exist.

methods.name: getModelEntityNoCheck
methods.description: Fetches a ModelEntity object by name without performing validation.

methods.name: getEntityNamesIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over all entity names defined in the model.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all entity names currently loaded.

methods.name: getEntitiesByPackage
methods.description: Returns a map of package names to sets of entity names, filtered by optional package and entity sets.

methods.name: validateEntityName
methods.description: Validates and potentially trims an entity name to ensure it exists within the known entities.

methods.name: createModelEntity
methods.description: Creates a new ModelEntity instance from an XML element.

methods.name: createModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a new ModelViewEntity instance from an XML element.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Constructs a ModelRelation object representing a relationship between entities.

methods.name: incrementFieldCount
methods.description: Increments the model's internal count of fields by a specified amount.
